baseline.notes: DataForSEO now detects one referring domain. This remains a very low-authority baseline, so the first priority is trusted MCP ecosystem distribution rather than high-volume generic directory submission.

used_for: referring-domain samples for Baserow, NocoDB, and Grist
live Google US SERPs for MCP directories, database MCP roundups, AI-agent directories, and Airtable alternatives
domain rank, referring-domain, backlink, and spam-score checks for shortlisted targets
live extraction of official registry, MCP directory, Smithery, and SaaSHub submission requirements
live extraction of database MCP and general MCP listicles before qualification
community-list contribution rules, repository activity, stars, and recent merged submissions

qualification_rules: Prefer MCP-native surfaces and source-backed editorial targets over generic launch directories.
Keep Rowset positioned as an agent-managed dataset layer, not a direct SQL proxy or spreadsheet replacement.
Record paid, nofollow, account-age, authentication, and packaging constraints before submission.
Do not submit, publish, open upstream pull requests, or send outreach during this research phase.

targets.name: Official MCP Registry
targets.relevance: The canonical registry supports remote Streamable HTTP servers and secret HTTP-header configuration. Registry entries can also propagate to downstream aggregators.
targets.evidence: Official documentation shows a remotes entry for Streamable HTTP and a headers array for required secret credentials. DataForSEO reports domain rank 529 and 21,933 referring domains.
requirements: Create a valid server.json entry for https://rowset.lvtd.dev/mcp/
Declare the required Authorization header as a secret
Choose and verify a namespace, likely through GitHub or DNS authentication
Publish with mcp-publisher and verify the registry API result
targets.link_expectation: canonical ecosystem listing with downstream distribution; exact link attributes vary by aggregator
targets.next_action: Open a separate implementation PR for server.json and registry validation, then obtain Rasul's approval before running the public publish command.

targets.name: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers
targets.relevance: The 91,000-star list has active Database and Data Platform categories and explicitly accepts one-server pull requests.
targets.evidence: GitHub showed 91,454 stars, same-day repository activity, recent merged server additions, and contribution rules for a linked repository plus a concise categorized description.
requirements: Add one alphabetized Rowset entry under Data Platforms rather than direct Databases
Link the Rowset GitHub repository
Describe the hosted MCP and agent-managed dataset boundary accurately
Use the repository's one-server-per-line format
targets.link_expectation: dofollow GitHub README link to the Rowset repository; strong discovery and secondary citation value
targets.next_action: Draft the exact list entry and open an upstream PR only after Rasul approves the public submission.

targets.name: MCP.Directory
targets.relevance: MCP-native directory with dedicated Databases, Analytics and Data, Remote Server, and publisher surfaces.
targets.evidence: The live form accepts a GitHub repository, optional package fields, a short description, and optional email, then reviews within 24 hours. DataForSEO reports rank 144 and 218 referring domains.
requirements: GitHub repository URL
Short description positioning Rowset as an agent-managed dataset backend
Optional notification email
targets.link_expectation: listing and discovery link; link attribute is not stated
targets.next_action: Submit the GitHub repository and request Databases plus Analytics and Data categorization after approval.

targets.name: Glama MCP Registry
targets.relevance: Large MCP registry with server, connector, tool, database, and remote-server discovery surfaces.
targets.evidence: Glama's live site says maintainers can list a server for free from a GitHub repository. DataForSEO reports rank 478, 2,107 referring domains, and spam score 3.
requirements: Sign in and choose Add Server
Connect the LVTD-LLC/rowset repository
Provide test credentials or contact support if the authenticated hosted endpoint cannot be scanned
Claim the resulting listing with maintainer verification
targets.link_expectation: public server page with repository and product discovery links
targets.next_action: Attempt the GitHub-based Add Server flow after approval; stop before providing any production credential if a safe test account is not available.

targets.name: Awesome MCP Servers
targets.relevance: MCP-native directory with explicit Database and Remote Server categories.
targets.evidence: The live form asks for name, short description, GitHub or docs link, category, and contact email. DataForSEO reports rank 271 and 1,287 referring domains.
requirements: Use the Database category
Link the MCP guide or GitHub repository
Provide a contact email
targets.link_expectation: free listing; the site reserves a dofollow link for premium submissions
targets.next_action: Use the free submission first; do not pay for premium review without a separate ROI decision.

targets.name: MCP.so
targets.relevance: High-visibility MCP marketplace with a separate remote-server submission path.
targets.evidence: The live flow accepts a repository URL and name. DataForSEO reports rank 363 and 1,956 referring domains.
requirements: Use Remote Server rather than local MCP Server
Provide repository URL and Rowset name
Verify the approved listing accurately explains bearer-key authentication
targets.link_expectation: free listings are explicitly nofollow; premium listings are dofollow
targets.next_action: Use the free remote-server submission after approval; do not purchase premium placement during the first pass.

targets.name: SaaSHub
targets.relevance: Established software-alternatives directory that accepts released SaaS products and asks submitters to name competitors.
targets.evidence: The live form accepts SaaS products, requires a working product URL, recommends categories and competitors, and offers domain-email verification. DataForSEO reports rank 575 and 11,188 referring domains.
requirements: Create or use a SaaSHub account
Submit the production homepage
Choose API Tools, Developer Tools, and Database-adjacent categories where available
List Airtable, Baserow, NocoDB, and Grist as adjacent products without claiming feature parity
Verify with a rowset.lvtd.dev or lvtd.dev email if supported
targets.link_expectation: product profile and alternatives discovery; exact link attribute is not stated by SaaSHub
targets.next_action: Prepare the profile copy and screenshots, then submit after approval.

targets.name: AlternativeTo
targets.relevance: Large software-alternatives database where Rowset can be related to Airtable, Baserow, NocoDB, and Grist while preserving its narrower agent-backend positioning.
targets.evidence: The official FAQ documents Suggest new application and Suggest Alternatives flows and a one-week wait for new accounts. DataForSEO reports rank 512 and 37,514 referring domains.
requirements: Use a personal account at least one week old
Submit Rowset as a web application with open-source and self-hosted attributes
Suggest only defensible adjacent products
Use a description that explicitly says Rowset is not a full no-code app builder
targets.link_expectation: software profile with official website link
targets.next_action: Check whether Rasul already has an eligible account; otherwise create one only with approval and wait one week before submission.

targets.name: OpenAlternative
targets.relevance: Curated open-source alternatives directory that includes self-hosted software and already appears among Baserow's referring domains.
targets.evidence: The live site exposes a signed-in submission flow. DataForSEO competitor research found openalternative.co among Baserow's referring domains; the domain has rank 387 and 874 referring domains.
requirements: Sign in to the submitter dashboard
Provide the LVTD-LLC/rowset repository and hosted product URL
Position Rowset as an open-source, self-hostable agent dataset backend
Use Airtable or Baserow only as adjacent comparison anchors
targets.cost: free submission path appears available; approval is curated
targets.next_action: Prepare project metadata and submit after approval.

targets.name: OpenSourceAlternative.to
targets.relevance: Open-source and self-hosted directory with an explicit proprietary-alternative mapping.
targets.evidence: The live form requires website, repository, and proprietary comparison fields. DataForSEO reports rank 276 and 903 referring domains.
requirements: Provide email, website, repository, and one proprietary comparison
Use Airtable as the closest proprietary comparison but preserve Rowset's narrower scope
Choose between the free waitlist and paid review
targets.cost: free waitlist with stated 6+ month delay; optional $29 review
targets.link_expectation: directory project and repository links if approved
targets.next_action: Use the free waitlist after approval; do not purchase expedited review in the first pass.

targets.name: Product Hunt
targets.relevance: High-authority product-discovery surface that can provide a durable profile and launch-day distribution when Rowset has a launch story worth coordinating.
targets.evidence: Product Hunt's official guide says launches are free, use personal accounts, and can be scheduled up to one month ahead. DataForSEO reports rank 684 and 136,148 referring domains.
requirements: Use a personal Product Hunt account
Confirm Rowset has not already been submitted
Prepare logo, gallery, tagline, description, maker comment, and launch-day support
Coordinate timing as a separate launch rather than a background directory submission
targets.link_expectation: product profile and launch page with website link
targets.next_action: Treat as a separate launch project; do not submit casually as part of the directory batch.

targets.name: MCP.Directory: Best Database MCP Servers in 2026
targets.relevance: The article ranks for database MCP queries and already explains the direct-database model. Rowset can add a distinct agent-managed dataset option rather than displacing a direct SQL server.
targets.evidence: Jina extraction verified a current 10-product roundup, decision tree, comparison matrix, and explicit database-model segmentation.
requirements: Get the MCP.Directory listing approved first
Pitch an additional decision branch for hosted agent-managed datasets
Lead with the direct-database versus Rowset boundary and link to the existing guide
Do not claim Rowset is a universal SQL connector
targets.link_expectation: contextual editorial link if the article is updated
targets.next_action: Draft a short evidence-led correction/addition pitch after the directory listing is live; send only with approval.

targets.name: Developers Digest: The Best MCP Servers in 2026
targets.relevance: Current 184-server directory and roundup aimed at developers comparing MCP tools.
targets.evidence: Jina extraction verified the article and linked searchable directory. The contact page explicitly accepts feedback and corrections by email. DataForSEO reports rank 217 and 320 referring domains.
requirements: Provide a working remote MCP endpoint and repository
Pitch Rowset under database or data-platform tooling
Include one concrete setup example and the honest direct-database boundary
targets.cost: editorial outreach; partnership options also exist but are not required
targets.link_expectation: directory or contextual editorial link if accepted
targets.next_action: Prepare a concise inclusion request for the directory; send only with approval.

targets.name: Bill Doerrfeld / InfoWorld database MCP roundup
targets.relevance: The author covers database MCP architecture and maintains a direct contact path. Rowset offers an adjacent hosted dataset-layer angle for a future update or follow-up.
targets.evidence: Jina extraction verified the author's June 2026 database MCP research summary and linked InfoWorld roundup. DataForSEO reports rank 179 and 91 referring domains.
requirements: Pitch as a distinct architecture option, not a missing direct database connector
Offer the open-source repository, hosted endpoint, and direct-versus-managed guide
Avoid requesting a link without a substantive editorial angle
targets.link_expectation: possible future article or update citation; lower certainty than directory submissions
targets.next_action: Draft a two-paragraph research note around agent-managed datasets; send only with approval.

targets.name: K2view: Awesome MCP servers
targets.relevance: The roundup evaluates enterprise-data, public-API, and database MCP options and includes a structured comparison table.
targets.evidence: Jina extraction verified the current 15-server comparison and its enterprise-data framing. DataForSEO reports rank 309 and 2,267 referring domains.
requirements: Pitch Rowset as a small-team, agent-managed structured-data option
Acknowledge K2view's enterprise scope and avoid direct feature-equivalence claims
Provide the open-source repository and MCP decision guide
targets.link_expectation: possible contextual addition; vendor-owned editorial means acceptance is uncertain
targets.next_action: Keep as a second-wave pitch after Rowset has registry listings and usage proof.

targets.name: Smithery
targets.relevance: Major MCP distribution surface for remote servers with server pages, scanning, and usage analytics.
targets.evidence: The live publication docs require Streamable HTTP and OAuth when authentication is required. Rowset currently uses bearer API keys rather than OAuth. DataForSEO reports rank 458 and 2,366 referring domains.
requirements: Confirm whether Smithery URL publishing can safely collect a bearer API key through a configuration schema
If not, add OAuth support or a compatible static server card before publishing
Never expose a production Rowset API key to an unaudited scanner
targets.cost: publication path appears free; compatibility work may require engineering
targets.link_expectation: public server page and marketplace discovery after compatibility is resolved
targets.next_action: Ask Smithery support whether bearer-header configuration is supported for authenticated remote servers; proceed only after a safe path is confirmed.

excluded_or_deferred.name: PulseMCP direct submission
excluded_or_deferred.reason: PulseMCP documents its subregistry as read-only and does not implement a publish endpoint. Treat it as potential downstream distribution from the official MCP Registry, not a separate submission.

excluded_or_deferred.name: modelcontextprotocol/servers community listing PR
excluded_or_deferred.reason: The repository now houses only steering-group reference implementations and directs public servers to the official registry.

excluded_or_deferred.name: MCPTrove
excluded_or_deferred.reason: DataForSEO reports rank 0, two referring domains, two backlinks, and spam score 72. Defer until the directory develops stronger independent signals.

excluded_or_deferred.name: G2, Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice
excluded_or_deferred.reason: These review marketplaces are better after Rowset has an established category, customers willing to review it, and repeatable product proof. Premature profiles would be thin and hard to maintain.

excluded_or_deferred.name: Generic AI tool directories
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Broad AI directories are less relevant than MCP-native and open-source surfaces, often have unclear editorial standards, and would dilute the first outreach batch.
